definitionZh: 网格浏览端 CSS 属性通过给其网格位置贡献一条线,一个跨度,或无(自动)来指定网格项目在网格行内的端位置,从而指定其网格区域的内端边缘.
sourceDefinition: The grid-row-end CSS property specifies a grid item's end position within the grid row by contributing a line, a span, or nothing (automatic) to its grid placement, thereby specifying the inline-end edge of its grid areas.
